# Lake Olympia Animal Hospital

> A full-service veterinary clinic in Missouri City, Texas providing comprehensive pet healthcare including emergency services, wellness exams, surgical procedures, dental care, and specialized feline medicine.

Lake Olympia Animal Hospital is a Missouri City-based veterinary practice offering preventative care, emergency services, and specialized treatments for dogs and cats. The clinic features experienced veterinarians affiliated with major veterinary organizations and provides services ranging from puppy/kitten care to senior pet geriatrics and surgical procedures.

## Core Services

- [Pet Care Services](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/service): Directory of pet care services including wellness, surgery, grooming, and rehabilitation.
- [Emergency Pet Healthcare](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/emergency): Emergency pet healthcare services and after-hours care contacts.
- [Sick Pet Care](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/sick-pet-care): Urgent sick pet care and emergency veterinary services.
- [Veterinary Surgery Services](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/veterinary-surgery-services): Veterinary surgery including spay, neuter, and surgical procedures.
- [Pet Dental Cleaning](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/pet-dental-cleaning): Professional pet dental cleaning and plaque prevention service.
- [Pet Rehabilitation](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/pet-care-services/rehab): Pet rehabilitation with hydrotherapy and therapeutic laser.

## Wellness & Preventative Care

- [Wellness Exams](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/pet-care-services/wellness-exams): Wellness exams for puppies, kittens, adults, and senior pets.
- [Puppy Care Guide](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/pet-care-services/puppy): Puppy care guide with vaccination schedule and deworming info.
- [Kitten Care Guide](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/pet-care-services/kitten): Kitten care guide with vaccinations and parasite prevention.
- [Adult Pet Care](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/pet-care-services/adult): Adult pet wellness and preventative care recommendations.
- [Senior Pet Care](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/pet-care-services/senior): Senior pet care and geriatric health screening services.

## Specialized Services

- [Feline Specialist Services](https://lakeolympiaanimal.com/pet-care-services/feline-specialist): Feline specialist Dr. Mary McCaine's cat care services.
